title: 2.2 Streets and Transportation
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Recognize and name a street, bridge, bus, car, and bike using the established it identity frame.
grammar_function: It is a noun; negative contrast (It is a... not a...).
prerequisite: 2.1 place identities and Unit 1 not negation.
speaking_outcome: Name all five surroundings/transport items and one contrast sentence intelligibly.
